brief:
Israeli forces killed at least 17 Palestinians in Gaza during the days following a meeting with Kushner, Zeteo reported. The deaths occurred as Israel continued military operations across the territory. The visit took place while the conflict remained active in occupied Palestinian territories.

The killings marked part of a broader pattern of violence spanning Gaza and the West Bank. Israeli military operations proceeded through the week documented in the report. The casualties added to the overall death toll from conflict in the region, which has persisted across recent months as operations in occupied Palestinian areas have continued.
dek: Zeteo’s weekly round-up of the stories you may have missed out of occupied Gaza and the West Bank, as Israel continues its genocidal war and apartheid policies.
title: Israel kills at least 17 Palestinians in Gaza after Kushner meeting
